title: Design: report links are blue at regular weight
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role, with {Location-A} as your current location.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Customer {Customer-A} has an open invoice at your location on today's date.
    For example: {Customer-A} is ZZAUTOTEST D-80 Link Weight.
  • Starting screen: A/R Detail (Reports, then "A/R Aging Detail" under ACCOUNTS RECEIVABLE in the left menu) is open in a desktop browser window 1440 px wide, as opened from the Reports menu in light theme at 100% zoom, with every bucket expanded.
  • The design pictures "Links only where they can open" (ar-ap-p5-links-only-where-they-can-open.png) and "A/R Aging Summary opens A to Z" (ar-ap-p1-a-r-aging-summary-opens-a-to-z.png) are attached to this case and open beside the browser at 100% zoom; compare the layout, labels and styles, not the names and amounts, which are only examples.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Compare {Customer-A}'s invoice number with the plain text next to it.
  2. Open A/R Summary and compare a customer name with the Location text next to it.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the number is blue and of the same weight as the plain text, not semi-bold, as in the picture.
  • Step 2: the name is blue and of the same weight as the Location text, as in the picture.

Held: this is the design's version of a difference from the PRD. Question 15 on Chris Ward's question sheet (added 22 Oct 2026) decides it. If the design wins, this case is released and the PRD-following cases change; if the PRD wins, this case is deleted with the QA lead's go-ahead.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 5 (21 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 22 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11537 (Story 7, Document links open where they can)

  • S7-R7: “Links use the native report link style (the same blue as Work In Progress, semi-bold, no underline, underlined only on keyboard focus), readable in light and dark theme.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "A/R and A/P Report Sorting" (https://claude.ai/artifact/BRYCdjKwGRSgGPC9xxkgF4), read 22 Oct 2026: page 1 "Opening order and header sorting" (board Main.dc.html); page 5 "Document links and Switch location" (board Links.dc.html). This held case follows the design picture below, not the PRD sentence quoted above (Rule 130 item 5): the quote shows what the PRD says today, the picture what the design shows.

Design pictures attached to this case:

  • ar-ap-p5-links-only-where-they-can-open.png: figure "Links only where they can open" (This build (after)), board "5. Document links and Switch location (SV-5706)"
  • ar-ap-p1-a-r-aging-summary-opens-a-to-z.png: figure "A/R Aging Summary opens A to Z" (This build (after)), board "1. Opening order and header sorting"

The design's own words:

  • "A number links only with the right permission and a location the user works at; otherwise plain text. Native link style. S7-R1, S7-R2, S7-R6, S7-R7, S7-N1, S7-N2." (caption of "Links only where they can open")
  • "Customer name order the way QuickBooks sorts ("10 Trucking" before "2 Trucking"), marked on the Customer header. S1-R1, S1-R2, S1-R4, S1-R7, S1-R8." (caption of "A/R Aging Summary opens A to Z")

Difference from the PRD (DD-05): the PRD says "the same blue as Work In Progress, semi-bold, no underline" (S7-R7); the design shows document numbers and customer and vendor names are blue at the same (regular) weight as the plain text beside them. This held case follows the design; the difference is question 15 on Chris Ward's question sheet (added 22 Oct 2026); the design version is this case.

AUTOMATION: HOLD - the design differs from the PRD, waiting on the PO
